section.name: Overview
section.p: Core language support for JavaScript is provided by an adapted version of the Mozilla Rhino engine. HtmlUnit provides browser-specific host objects such as Document, Window, or Navigator.

section.name: SimpleScriptable
section.p: All of HtmlUnit's JavaScript host objects subclass SimpleScriptable either directly or indirectly. This class contains common utility methods needed by HtmlUnit host objects. Additionally, it customizes how JavaScript method lookup is performed: while the standard Rhino engine does not walk up the class hierarchy when looking for accessor methods starting with jsGet_, jsSet_, or jsFunction_, SimpleScriptable alters this behavior so that the superclass hierarchy is walked.

section.name: Debugging JavaScript Errors
section.p: Testing pages containing JavaScript can produce errors for several reasons. Some web browsers support non-standard DOM shortcuts or extensions that HtmlUnit does not yet emulate. When inline JavaScript code is executed, HtmlUnit wraps it in a synthetic function, which can make error stack traces harder to decipher.
To assist with debugging, setting the logger org.htmlunit.javascript to the DEBUG log level will cause HtmlUnit to log the generated wrapper functions along with the original inline code.
To help identify missing property definitions, HtmlUnit emits WARN level log entries when expected objects are undefined. Before reporting JavaScript issues, please read Submitting JavaScript Bugs.
